title: Popullsia sipas llojit të vendbanimit (urban/rural), gjinisë dhe grupmoshës, në nivel vendi dhe komune, për vitet 2011 dhe 2024
download_date_note: The original download date was not recorded.
limitations: The source notes refer to 34 municipalities in 2011 and 38 in 2024.
Northern municipalities were not enumerated in 2011; their exported zero counts are treated as missing.
Participation in northern municipalities was incomplete in 2024.
Model preparation excludes records with specific coverage warnings; other outputs retain those warnings.
